text:
Hi all,

I started learning Piano a while ago, memorising songs from YouTube and graduating to learning classical pieces from sheet music that are too hard for me. It's typical, and you can express yourself through piece selection, and dynamics etc but this is quite limited. I reflected on why I want to play; to be able to sit and improvise, to freely express myself, to make my own music. So I created Noodle; she's a little companion you connect to your digital piano and she guides you through chord progressions, inversions, licks, and traditional scale exercises, guiding you to make nice sounding music.

Would appreciate any feedback, and I've included 20 redemption codes for the lifetime license at the end of the post.

Cheers, Rahil
